To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
cis-dioxorhodium(V) complexes supported by chiral tetradenate N4 ligand were prepared and their electronic and spectroscopic properties were investigated.
cis-dioxorhhenium(V/ VI) complexes supported by chiral tetradenrate N4 ligands have been synthesized, characterized, and their spectroscopic properties have been studied.

the cis-dioxo rhenium(V) complex supported by neutral tetradentate ligands is stable in solution, and the electronic structure and spectroscopic properties can be predicted by DFT and TTDFT calculations.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the synthesis, characterization, and spectroscopy of cis-dioxo complexes of rhenium supported by neutral tetradentate ligands, and the reactivity of these complexes in oxidation reactions of weak C-H bonds.
the synthesis, characterization, and spectroscopic properties, as well as the reactivity of cis-dioxo complexes of rhenium(V) and rhenium(VI) with tetradentate chiral ligands.

the design, synthesis, and characterization of a new series of cis-dioxidorhenium(V/V) complexes with neutral tetradentate ligands, and the investigation of their electronic absorption spectra and reactivity toward organic substrates.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the cis-dioxo rhenium complexes with tetradentate ligands are not only interesting from the viewpoint of their structures and spectroscopic features, but also have the potential to be applied to oxidation catalysis.
the cis-dioxo complexes are more stable in the V state, while the trans-dioxo complexes in the V state are more stable than the VI state.
the dioxorhenium complexes are not very reactive in oxidation reactions, but the complexes can be oxidized easily to the dioxoruthenium complexes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
cis-[ReV/O(OH)(pyxn)]n+ (n = 1, 2) is a good model for the cis-dioxo intermediate in the reaction of [ReO3]2- with organic substrates.
cis-dioxorhodium(V) complexes with tetradentate neutral N4 ligands can be readily prepared, and their electronic structures and spectroscopy can be rationalized by DFT/TDDFT calculations.

(a) the cis-dioxo Re(V) complexes with N4 ligands are stable in air and water, (b) the N4 ligands can be used to construct chiral cis-dioxo complexes, (c) the N4 complexes can be oxidized to cis-dioxo rhenium(VI) complexes, and (d) the N4 cis-dioxo compounds are efficient oxidants for weak C-H bonds.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cis-dioxo complexes are more reactive than the trans-isomers toward hydrogen atom abstraction.
the Re=O bonds in the cis-dioxo complexes are significantly longer than those in their isomeric trans-dioxo complexes.

the electronic structures and reactivity patterns of cis-dioxo complexes of rhenium can be modulated by changing the chelate ring size and by varying the steric environment of the chelating N4 ligand.
